direction: Middle ground between fine engraving and crude felt-tip art

illustrations.name: hero
illustrations.prompt: Use case illustration-story. CAIRN 1980s sword-and-sorcery game manual illustration. MID-LEVEL vintage commercial pen-and-ink craft: solid anatomy and confident readable silhouettes, bold thick outer contours, medium interior lines, modest widely spaced hatching, occasional flat black shadows. Hand drawn and slightly rough, NOT crude amateur, NOT cartoon caricature, NOT intricate fine-art engraving. Between polished detailed fantasy engraving and crude felt-tip zine art. Strict black ink on plain WHITE background. No fine dense crosshatching, no grey washes, no paper texture, no color, no text. Portrait full body muscular long black-haired bare-chested barbarian in fur loincloth, ornate bracers and fur boots holding large double-headed axe atop cairn stones. Simple broken stone arch behind, one raven. Strong serious face, grounded anatomy, expressive moderately detailed bold drawing.
